question: Who is the true recipient of Śiva-hood despite sectional divisions in the teaching?
premises: The qualified person is indeed one and is the recipient of attaining Śiva-hood.
Even so, the teaching may arise in the form of limited sections.
Sectional presentation does not multiply the ultimate qualified recipient or the final attainment.
inference: Therefore, despite sectional divisions, there is one qualified recipient whose true attainment is Śiva-hood.
plain_english: The qualified person is truly one, the recipient of attaining Śiva-hood; even when the teaching appears only in limited sectional form, that single qualification and attainment remain.
